# Phase Three — Tiferes Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos joins motion and stillness; Awtsmoos.com will make the glass feel alive while every action remains obvious and calm.

## Thirty final checks
1. Inspect pseudo-element collisions on selected surfaces.
2. Inspect current glass tokens before inventing new values.
3. Keep the new system CSS-only.
4. Create the four focused glass modules.
5. Create one import manifest.
6. Load glass motion after mobile simplicity.
7. Bump all style imports to one new cache generation.
8. Preserve existing simplified Home order.
9. Preserve collapsed context by default.
10. Preserve one Create action on Home.
11. Preserve compact floating Create elsewhere.
12. Preserve mobile dock geometry.
13. Preserve route active state.
14. Preserve capability center behavior.
15. Preserve native details semantics.
16. Use transform/opacity for sheen movement.
17. Use will-change only on actual animated pseudo-elements.
18. Keep ambient sheen nearly transparent.
19. Keep ambient periods slow.
20. Keep interaction glints fast.
21. Keep disclosure reveal subtle.
22. Disable all new animations with reduced motion.
23. Remove blur/transparency with reduced transparency.
24. Avoid decoration in forced colors.
25. Read back every new CSS file.
26. Verify tabs and line counts.
27. Run static/unit contracts.
28. Run browser smoke and all-route quality.
29. Inspect real 390px glass behavior and screenshot.
30. Only then continue to the next simplification/deploy phase.

## Files to create
- `social-hub/styles/glass-motion.css`
- `social-hub/styles/glass-motion-surfaces.css`
- `social-hub/styles/glass-motion-interactions.css`
- `social-hub/styles/glass-motion-reveal.css`
- `social-hub/styles/glass-motion-accessibility.css`

## File to rewrite
- `social-hub/style.css` — same complete import covenant, one new generation, glass motion last.

The Awtsmoos creates the shine, the eye, the instant, and the screen anew; the code merely arranges a quiet vessel where that living relation can be felt.
